messages:
marta: APAC asia2 GPU pool reporting ~30% node evictions and P99 token latency spikes. Pagerbot paged. I'm standing up failover prep, tagging @liam @ashley

oncall-bot: Incident created: asia2-gpu-network-flap | severity: page | runbook: infra/gpu/failover | responder: liam

liam: on it. pulling runbook now. can someone confirm dedicated-asia2 spare capacity? @raj

raj: dedicated-asia2 is healthy but only ~40% spare. We can shift traffic to eu-west2 or burst to dedicated-us as a stopgap.

ashley: propose immediate plan: 1) traffic-shift latency-sensitive routes to eu-west2 2) scale dedicated-reserved by +2 nodes 3) enable request-level fallback to quantized model-variants to reduce memory pressure. any objections?

liam: +1 to that plan. start traffic-shift for route /v1/generate. use 60% to eu-west2 as phased roll.

ashley: running commands from ops box now:
```bash
# run from ops workstation
traffic-shift --route /v1/generate --from asia2 --to eu-west2 --percent 60 --dry-run=false
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/ops/rollout -d '{"route":"generate","target":"eu-west2","weight":0.6}'
```

oncall-bot: Traffic-shift change queued. Change-id: 654321. Will report apply status.

marta: I'll own the first 2h. @ashley please do the scale-up and annotate cost delta. @liam monitor tail logs+traces and watch p99.

ashley: scaling dedicated-asia2 +2 nodes (req id: scale-987). ETA ~3m. cost delta estimate: +$0.8k/hr if we keep burst on.

liam: seeing repeated 502s from fabric-switch-3, packet drops on east spine. tagging net-team.

net-team: ack. investigating AS path and spooler. will attempt SP reroute and check MTU. ETA 8m.

oncall-bot: Traffic-shift executed: /v1/generate => eu-west2 60% | changeset id 654321 | status: applied

marta: good. also proposing small pagerbot tweak to reduce duplicate noise: dedupe window 10m and require 2 unique runbook hits before full escalation. Thoughts?

liam: sounds good, reduces churn during noisy network events. +1 to the 2-hit threshold. please file the PR.

ashley: documented the cost and runbook steps in the incident doc. handing off ops to @raj in 1h. incident doc: https://confluence.internal/asia2-network-flap-1790123456

raj: taking over at 18:25 UTC. will watch for net-team confirmation and start ramp-down plan once packet loss <0.1% for 5m.

marta: thanks all :thumbsup: closing initial page. keep thread updates brief unless there's regression or rollback required.
